"""Merge origin/main (or the updated parent branch) into each PR head by plumbing; prints new commit ids, pushes with --push."""
import subprocess, sys, json

SESSION = "Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED"
# (pr, branch, parent branch or None for main)
PLAN = [
    ("243", "ci/allow-list-directory", None),
    ("234", "ci/triage-parity-regressions", None),
    ("236", "ci/notify-homebrew-tap", None),
    ("240", "docs/cleanup-stale-docs-adrs", None),
    ("229", "feat/tagged-factory-components", None),
    ("232", "feat/semantic-on-demand", None),
    ("233", "feat/function-param-flags", "feat/tagged-factory-components"),
    ("235", "fix/react-props-never-omitted", "feat/semantic-on-demand"),
    ("241", "perf/component-lookups-by-name", "fix/react-props-never-omitted"),
    ("244", "fix/forwardref-by-shape", "perf/component-lookups-by-name"),
]
PUSH = "--push" in sys.argv


def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", *a], capture_output=True, text=True)


new = {}
for pr, branch, parent in PLAN:
    head = git("rev-parse", f"origin/{branch}").stdout.strip()
    other = new[parent] if parent else git("rev-parse", "origin/main").stdout.strip()
    if git("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", other, head).returncode == 0:
        print(f"#{pr} already contains {'parent' if parent else 'main'}")
        new[branch] = head
        continue
    m = git("merge-tree", "--write-tree", "--name-only", head, other)
    if m.returncode != 0:
        print(f"#{pr} CONFLICT:\n{m.stdout}")
        sys.exit(1)
    tree = m.stdout.splitlines()[0]
    what = parent or "main"
    msg = f"Merge {what} into {branch}\n\n{SESSION}"
    c = git("commit-tree", tree, "-p", head, "-p", other, "-m", msg).stdout.strip()
    new[branch] = c
    print(f"#{pr} {branch} -> {c[:10]}")
    if PUSH:
        p = git("push", "origin", f"{c}:refs/heads/{branch}")
        print("   push", p.returncode, p.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr.strip() else "")
        if p.returncode != 0:
            sys.exit(1)
